headline: Indian government bond yields drop as crude prices and US Treasury yields retreat
summary: India's benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield fell to 7.2393% from 7.2528%, extending a rally supported by lower oil prices and easing US sovereign bond yields.
why: Indian sovereign bond yields set domestic borrowing benchmarks; lower yields reduce financing costs across government and corporate credit markets.

impacts.name: India benchmark bond yield
impacts.why: Bond prices rose and yields fell as softening crude prices reduced domestic inflation risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Falling international oil prices and softer US Treasury yields boosted buying in Indian sovereign debt.
